caption: A floating-point argument evaluates directly to a decimal
m greater than 1, via the reciprocal-modulus transformation
Symbolic arguments are left unevaluated rather than guessed at

N(…, 50) asks for more digits than the plain-double AGM kernel can supply (~17): rather than print a double as if it had 50 correct digits, this stays unevaluated — the kernel has no bignum companion (see exceedsDoublePrecision, ce-patches/src/support/precise.ts).
